# SpeciesProtectionMechanism

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method within the evolutionary synthesis that allocates computational resources to underperforming species to maintain genetic diversity and explore niche topologies. Prevents dominance by a single topology family, crucial for discovering unconventional TCC interconnects that may offer superior latency or energy efficiency.
